page.layout: One printed page: one column of running text, no margin notes, no notes below the text. Top: page number 94 and running head "DE LEGAT. EVANGEL.".

main_text.p: dbus[?] communicare, magnumque & excelsum super omnes Deos tertæ fieri, voluerunt. Terrenisq; ocij & molliciei posthabitis tabernaculis, juret Domino, atque votum voveat potenti ipsius Iaacob, sic non daturum requiem animæ suæ, nec somnum oculis suis concessurum, donec invenerit locum Æterno, manfionem Forti ipsius Iaacob. Confumat ipsum zelus domus Domini, & reparare nitatur fissuras murorum Sion: exaltet Deum suum coram populis, doceat eos, quod magnus Dominus & laudabilis valde, & magnitudinis ejus quod non sit investigatio: memoriam multitudinis bonitatis divinæ eructet & justitiam ejus proclamet, ut notas faciat Filijs hominū fortitudines ejus, & gloriam splendoris regni ejus. Huc totus feratur, ut benedicat omnis caro nomini Domini sancto, in seculum & in perpetuum, utque lux salutaris Christi, sedentibus in tenebris & umbra mortis illucescat: hac via sine crimine coelestis honos ambitur, scala hæc est tutissima, quâ ad coelestia ascenditur. page.notes: Top line: the first word is partly cut off at the top of the scan; read as "dbus" with uncertain first letter, so marked [?]. "sic" at the start of a sentence is printed with a damaged letter; read as "sic", not fully certain. Running head printed "IVANGEL." and corrected to "EVANGEL." under the u/v rule. The printed text reads "Chriftiano" and "Chrifti" with long s, copied as plain s in "Christi". Catchword "mani" is the start of the next page's word "humani".
